cover.prompt: At the stone rampart of slope post 2 high on Mount Phyle, mercenary-2 in deep blue tunic leans intently over the stone parapet, shading his eyes with his hand, gazing down across the ravine to determine if a distant signal station is silent or merely delayed; beside him mercenary-4 in olive green stands holding a brass clepsydra (water timer) aloft with elbow bent at 25 degrees so light outlines the instrument against the rock; the ashlar wall angle of the watchpost anchors the left margin; the rugged vertical crags of the mountain wall face the camera diagonally, delineated with crystal clarity and deep shadows under bright directional sunlight.
cover.others: a bronze signal shield resting against the wall.
